lines: d19: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Lucas Tapia is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d19: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d19: 🕯️ Lucas Tapia is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d19: What Lucas kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d19: "Lucas's gone." James looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Lucas." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d19: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Esteban blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d19: 📖 LEARNED: Silver Tongue (Level 1). Words are tools. You've got a whole workshop.
d19: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d19: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Lucas Tapia, 19 days. The mantle passes to Esteban Bah.
d19: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Esteban Bah, 36 — a radio DJ. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d19: The village's quarrel was with Lucas — and Lucas is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d19: At the grave, James, Marthe, Quinn speak for Esteban — "Lucas trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d19: The fire knew Esteban before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
d52: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Esteban Bah is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d52: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d52: 🕯️ Esteban is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d52: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

d52: Esteban is gone — dead. The errand dies with them; nobody's waiting on those dandelions now.
